answer: Reaching eligibility takes 40 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. The velvet register is checked at draw time, reef lists the eligible set, and gale seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 40 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 174 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
